name: Redstone Torch Random Tick
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: 2No2Name
description: Redstone Torch Random Tick makes burnt out redstone torches be reactived by random ticks, similar to older minecraft versions. This only affects non-scheduled, burnt-out torches, avoiding breaking any redstone contraptions!
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-20 (eda5a4a5) (8 classes, 6 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
